text.p: Frankfort First Bancorp Inc said on Thursday that it set a special $4.00 per share cash distribution and a one-for-two reverse stock split.
Frankfort said the reduction of net interest income that will result from the distribution will be offset by terminating the company's employee stock ownership and management recognition plans.
The company said it will compensate participants in these plans with a one-time after-tax charge of $1 million in the current quarter.
Frankfort said it expects future cost savings of about $500,000 per year from this action, offset however by the reduction in net interest income resulting from the cash distribution.
The special distribution is payable on June 24 to holders of record as of June 17. The company estimates that about 20 percent of it, or $0.80 per share, will be taxable.
The reverse stock split will be effective on July 15.
